description: Suggest a GitHub repository (an AI agent, MCP server or AI developer tool) for listing on AgentIndex. No login or API key needed. The submission is queued for human review, usually within 1-3 days; it does not appear in search results immediately. Tools are listed only if the repository is public and has at least 100 stars. Check with search_tools first that the tool is not already listed. Returns {success, message, github_url}, or an isError result if the URL is not a GitHub repository URL or the submission service is unavailable.

email.description: Optional address that receives an email when the review is done. Only send it if the user provided it.

github_url.description: Repository URL in the form https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>, e.g. https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers.

name: submit_tool
title: Submit a tool
